questions.question: As per the Union Budget 2026-27, non-residents under presumptive taxation are exempted from which of the following categories of taxes?
questions.questionHtml: As per the Union Budget 2026-27, non-residents under presumptive taxation are exempted from which of the following categories of taxes?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Minimum Alternate Tax (MAT).

In News

  • The Union Budget 2026-27 announced significant tax reforms to boost IT, investment, and global business.

Key Points

  • According to the Union Budget 2026-27, non-residents under presumptive taxation are exempted from Minimum Alternate Tax (MAT).
  • This measure is part of the government's effort to simplify the tax regime and improve the ease of doing business for global entities.
  • Additionally, foreign cloud service providers operating from India will enjoy tax holidays until 2047.
  • The Budget also proposes a unified safe harbour regime and higher thresholds for the IT sector.

Additional Information

  • Other Tax Reforms (Budget 2026-27)
    • New Income Tax Act, 2025: To be implemented from April 2026 with simplified rules.
    • Customs Duties: Import duties on personal-use goods are halved; specific drugs and rare disease treatments are fully exempted.
    • Accounting Standards: Proposal to align standards to eliminate dual compliance under tax and corporate laws.

questions.question: Which Union Ministry has launched the 'SAHI' and 'BODH' initiatives at India AI Impact Summit 2026?
questions.questionHtml: Which Union Ministry has launched the 'SAHI' and 'BODH' initiatives at India AI Impact Summit 2026?

options.text: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution
options.html: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution

options.text: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
options.html: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

options.text: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
options.html: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

questions.solution:
The correct answer is Ministry of Health and Family Welfare.

In News

  • Launch Date: February 17, 2026.
  • Occasion: India AI Impact Summit 2026 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
  • Dignitary: Launched by Shri Jagat Prakash Nadda, Union Minister of Health and Family Welfare.

Key Initiatives

  • SAHI (Strategy for Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare for India):
    • Functions as a national policy roadmap and governance framework.
    • Ensures AI integration remains accountable, equitable, and transparent.
    • Guides hospitals, states, and private partners on data stewardship and ethical AI deployment.
  • BODH (Benchmarking Open Data Platform for Health AI):
    • Developed by IIT Kanpur in collaboration with the National Health Authority (NHA).
    • Acts as a technical "testing ground" for AI tools before they are rolled out at population scale.
    • Uses privacy-preserving mechanisms to evaluate AI models using real-world data without exposing patient information.

Strategic Significance

  • Digital Public Infrastructure: These initiatives are digital public goods under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM).
  • Focus Areas: Prioritizes AI solutions for public health challenges like Tuberculosis (TB), maternal health, and non-communicable diseases.
  • Global Benchmark: The World Health Organization (WHO) highlighted that India is the first country in the South-East Asia region to adopt a comprehensive national AI strategy for health.

questions.question: The 16th Finance Commission (FC-16) has defined "Income Distance" based on which of the following calculations?
questions.questionHtml: The 16th Finance Commission (FC-16) has defined "Income Distance" based on which of the following calculations?

options.text: The difference between a state’s per capita GSDP and the state with the highest per capita GSDP.
options.html: The difference between a state’s per capita GSDP and the state with the highest per capita GSDP.

options.text: The difference between a state’s per capita GSDP and the average per capita GSDP of all states.
options.html: The difference between a state’s per capita GSDP and the average per capita GSDP of all states.

options.text: The difference between a state’s per capita GSDP and the national average GDP per capita.
options.html: The difference between a state’s per capita GSDP and the national average GDP per capita.

options.text: The difference between a state’s per capita GSDP and the average per capita GSDP of the top three large states with the highest per capita GSDP.
options.html: The difference between a state’s per capita GSDP and the average per capita GSDP of the top three large states with the highest per capita GSDP.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is The difference between a state’s per capita GSDP and the average per capita GSDP of the top three large states with the highest per capita GSDP.

In News

  • The 16th Finance Commission (FC-16) introduced a refined definition for 'Income Distance' to determine horizontal devolution for 2026-31.

Key Points

  • Income distance is now calculated as the gap between a state's per capita GSDP and the average of the top three large states with the highest per capita GSDP.
  • The Per capita GSDP is computed as the average over the period 2018-19 to 2023-24.
  • To ensure data accuracy and fairness, the pandemic year of 2020-21 has been excluded from this average calculation.
  • States with a lower per capita GSDP receive a higher share under this parameter to promote fiscal equity across the country.
  • Income Distance Statistics:
    • Weightage in FC-16 - 42.5%
    • Calculation Period - 2018-19 to 2023-24 (Excluding 2020-21)
    • Benchmark - Average of top 3 large states

Additional Information

  • GSDP (Gross State Domestic Product)
    • It represents the total value of all finished goods and services produced within a state's borders during a specific period.
  • Equity vs. Efficiency
    • Income Distance is an 'equity' parameter (helping poorer states), while the new 'Contribution to GDP' is an 'efficiency' parameter (rewarding productive states).
  • 15th FC Comparison
    • The 15th FC typically used the distance from the single highest-income state, whereas the 16th FC uses an average of the top three to create a more stable benchmark.
  • Horizontal Devolution
    • The allocation of the 41% tax pool among states based on the formula containing Income Distance, Population, Area, etc.

questions.question: What is the name of the initiative launched on the BHASHINI National Infrastructure at the India AI Impact Summit 2026?
questions.questionHtml: What is the name of the initiative launched on the BHASHINI National Infrastructure at the India AI Impact Summit 2026?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is VoicERA.

In News

  • VoicERA, an open-source end-to-end Voice AI stack, was launched on the BHASHINI National Language Infrastructure by the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology during the India AI Impact Summit 2026.
  • The initiative marks a significant milestone in India’s Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) journey.

Key Highlights of VoicERA

  • Launched by the Digital India BHASHINI Division (DIBD) under the Digital India Corporation (DIC), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
  • Launch led by Shri Amitabh Nag, CEO, DIBD, in collaboration with EkStep Foundation, COSS, IIIT Bengaluru, and AI4Bharat.
  • Designed to be open, pluggable, interoperable, cloud-deployable, and on-premise ready.
  • Reduces duplication of effort and eliminates vendor lock-in by modularising the voice technology stack.
  • Acts as a national execution layer for multilingual Voice and Language AI.

Objectives and Impact

  • Expands BHASHINI’s capabilities from translation services to real-time speech systems, conversational AI, and multilingual telephony.
  • Enables rapid onboarding of voice-enabled citizen services across sectors such as:
    • Agriculture advisories
    • Education support
    • Livelihood services
    • Grievance redressal
    • Citizen feedback systems
    • Scheme discovery platforms
  • Strengthens India’s sovereign language and voice AI ecosystem at population scale.
  • Promotes inclusive, secure, and scalable AI systems for next-generation public service delivery.

Additional Information

  • BHASHINI (Bhasha Interface for India): India’s National Language Infrastructure under the Digital India initiative aimed at enabling multilingual digital access.
  • Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY): The nodal ministry responsible for digital governance and Digital Public Infrastructure initiatives.
  • Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI): Refers to foundational digital systems such as identity, payments, and language infrastructure that enable large-scale public services.
  • VoicERA is positioned as a digital public good for voice, ensuring equitable access and enabling citizens to interact with the State in their own language.

questions.question: Which edition of the Durand Cup was inaugurated by President Droupadi Murmu in 2025?
questions.questionHtml: Which edition of the Durand Cup was inaugurated by President Droupadi Murmu in 2025?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is 134th.

Key Points

  • The Durand Cup is one of the oldest football tournaments in the world and the oldest in Asia.
  • The year 2025 marks the 134th edition of this prestigious football tournament.
  • The President of India, Droupadi Murmu, inaugurated this edition, showcasing the importance of this tournament in the nation's sporting calendar.
  • The Durand Cup was first held in the year 1888, making it an integral part of India's football history.
  • The tournament is named after Mortimer Durand, who was a foreign secretary in colonial India during the 19th century.
  • The tournament is not just a sporting event but also holds historical significance as a symbol of India's rich footballing culture.
  • It features participation from both domestic football clubs and teams from different organizations, showcasing a mix of talent and competition.

Additional Information

  • 130th Edition
    • The 130th edition of the Durand Cup was held in 2021.
    • It was notable for being organized after a gap of a year due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
    • This edition was hosted in Kolkata, which is considered the football hub of India.
  • 132nd Edition
    • The 132nd edition of the Durand Cup was held in 2023.
    • This edition saw the participation of both Indian Super League (ISL) clubs and other renowned domestic teams, elevating the competition level.
    • It was a step towards enhancing the tournament's popularity and competitiveness.
  • 140th Edition
    • The 140th edition will be held in the future and is expected to continue the legacy of this prestigious tournament.
    • It will follow the pattern of fostering sportsmanship and football culture in India.

questions.question: Which language recently received "Classical Language" status at the national level?
questions.questionHtml: Which language recently received "Classical Language" status at the national level?
questions.solution:
The Correct answer is Marathi.

Key Points

  • Marathi was recently granted the status of a "Classical Language" at the national level in India.
  • A language is designated as a Classical Language when it meets certain criteria such as being of great antiquity, having a rich literary tradition, and being distinct from modern languages.
  • The recognition as a Classical Language brings several benefits, including financial assistance for the development of the language and its literature.
  • Marathi is an Indo-Aryan language spoken predominantly in the Indian state of Maharashtra.
  • It is one of the 22 scheduled languages of India as per the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution.
  • The language has a long and rich history, with written records dating back to around the 11th century.
  • Marathi literature is known for its diverse forms of poetry, prose, and drama.
  • The recognition is expected to further encourage the preservation, study, and promotion of Marathi culture and heritage.

Additional Information

  • Maithili
    • Maithili is one of the 22 scheduled languages of India as per the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution.
    • It is primarily spoken in the Indian state of Bihar and in parts of Nepal.
    • Maithili has a long literary history with significant contributions in poetry and folklore.
  • Awadhi
    • Awadhi is a dialect of the Eastern Hindi language group.
    • It is primarily spoken in the region of Awadh in Uttar Pradesh, India.
    • Awadhi has a rich tradition in literature, including works like the Ramcharitmanas by Tulsidas.
  • Braj
    • Braj is another dialect of the Western Hindi language group.
    • It is spoken mainly in the region of Braj Bhoomi, which includes parts of Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan.
    • Braj is known for its association with Lord Krishna and its contributions to Bhakti literature.
